title: Without Settings — Parts there is no Categories page
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'See Financial Data' but not 'Settings — Parts'.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:
